posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@21f3000759 @Mrinal.exe @22f3000671 @hemalatha @Subendu

Respected Sir/Madam,
Will topics like merging database, extracting data from database and automating scripts be asked in OPPE ??

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: There will be no questions based on database. Questions will be based on Week 1 to 9. The type of questions will be same as BPT questions, PPAs & GrPAs and OPPE will be conducted on VM.

posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@21f3000759
Is there any list of commands that are imprtant in OPPE, so that it will be easier during revision time.

Also, most of the questions in BPT , PPAs & GrPAs need the use of sed and awk commands to solve them, completely learning this will be helpful for solving most of the questions, right ??

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
There isn’t list of commands. The more you practice the better you get. You can practice at

  • hackerank if you want command-wise practice → link
  • vm has many questions such as q-grep, practice, oppe etc

Note:- I am not endorsing any platform. I simply used to practice for my oppe as well and found it useful that’s why I am sharing this.

posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@21f3000759
If I practice Hacker Rank will it be sufficient for my OPPE.
I mean will the questions of OPPE be at par with medium level questions in Hacker Rank.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
No hackerank has different kind of questions useful for getting good understanding of commands & corner cases

Refer to this post - Need Help regarding the Resources for OPPE - #2

posts.cooked: What is the syllabus for the upcoming OPPE (Dec 6 2025) and are we allowed to run man and info commands during the exam?

All the best.
